qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: High customer switching costs via co-developed flavor and fragrance formulations and proprietary pet food palatants (Diana Division). Ingredient costs represent <2% of finished consumer goods price, supporting tangible ROIC >15% and gross margin stability.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 4 (CAP = 5, REJECT). Long-term runway is impaired by global antitrust investigations into flavor/fragrance cartel pricing, decelerating volume growth, and aggressive M&A rollups (Swedencare, ADF/IDF) that diluted multi-year GAAP ROIC to 7-9%.
qualitative.evidence: Multi-year GAAP ROIC averaged 7.0-9.0% between 2021 and 2025, heavily diluted by €2.7B in goodwill and intangibles. The company faced cross-border antitrust probes into alleged fragrance price-fixing and forced regulatory remedies on pet food assets. Decelerating organic volume growth and FMCG customer consolidation curtail economic moat visibility below the 15-year hurdle.
